scope: Production native OpenAI Chat Mistral indexed direct body, mandatory stored estimate and automatic continuation within the executed domain. Phase 5/6/W26 remain open.
rootCause: Production selected legacy spoolChatBody for every format requiring ToolIdStore. Native Chat emission and measurements hard-coded plain IDs and tool result format; measured-pin mapping facts were not borrowed into either path.

red.initial: red.log: 0 pass / 9 fail at WireBodySpool.create under creation denial
red.purge: public-initial.log: selected purge pins failed before mapping activation/read-extent repair; complete 36-case public refresh now passes.
red.warm: planning-red.log: Mistral 40/4000 capture overlapped ROW/LENS 106/10666 times because two available length slots evicted one of three keys

implementation: Mistral detection uses the existing model/tool-format resolution. Kimi remains explicitly legacy. Native Mistral never falls back to a scratch index or body/estimator spool.

Mapping activation persists the existing versioned raw-ID/salt facts in slot 2. The measured snapshot supplies the existing JournalRequestMistral bounded pending overlay and NativeMistralRow per-unit adapter to both serialization and six-state measurement. Core imports no provider implementation.

Native request capture holds the measured mapping pin until awaited initial/continuation body retirement. Borrowed resolve queries also require the original indexed request to remain open. New-pin replacement reassigns alpha from salted 4Uq1sY29c to 4SftZvDMX while old emitted bytes stay unchanged.

Format keys include Mistral toolFormat, hash/salt/normalizer revision, model, endpoint, reasoning, output limits and estimator identity. Mismatched Mistral format with plain settings is rejected. Only a registration explicitly using the mapping slot can share its length slot; ordinary mapping-only reservations remain unavailable to other registrations.

Continuation reuses the captured history mapper. The bounded current SDK reply tail uses the unchanged old builder, including raw current-reply IDs and Mistral tool names. It does not remap the reply IDs with a fresh history map.

Cold first activation rebuilds mapping facts from raw journal ID pieces, followed by bounded length/converter fills and a distinct token-format fill. This is not a single merged cold mapping/length/token pass. Active registrations retain the existing incremental append hooks.
